g.text: BrewLite A2 - Ingredient checkout: reserve, pay with VNPay sandbox, cancel
Choose WALLET/CARD; press Pay with VNPay
Check selected sizes/toppings and aggregate cart availability
Disable button; create payment key (no card field)
POST /orders with JWT and cart; no client prices
Keep cart; ask customer to change the unavailable selection
Keep cart; report changed ingredients; link to edit cart
Keep orderId / owner / same payment key
Re-login same Customer; GET order and check owner/status;
resume existing order/key, never POST another order
Show receipt or current order status
D6: QueryDR 00/01 keeps PENDING only until
expiresAt + 15 min (grace). After that the payment is
closed as FAILED "EXPIRED" (last branch below), so an
abandoned payment cannot block the order forever.
409 PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS; no new URL, no new Payment, no cancel
Show "checking payment" with Check again; never advise paying twice
04/05/06/07/09 and MISMATCH never auto-close, even after
the grace; they stay PENDING for manual reconciliation.
MISMATCH applies to a signed 00 response only. Any other code
(91 too) with a wrong or missing merchant or TxnRef is
BAD_RESPONSE: 502 inside the grace, closed after it.
Show generic error; keep cart and order
Offer to continue the existing payment or check status
Show generic error; keep cart and order
redirect browser to paymentUrl; keep cart
Order and reservation stay as they are (Payment PENDING);
customer may return later (A6), or E11 applies after expiry
Return page checks signature via GET /payments/vnpay/return (display only);
poll GET /orders/:id every 2 s, at most 30 s
201 SUCCESS; receipt and tracking; clear cart
Show failure reason from the response code
(24 cancelled, 11/15/EXPIRED expired, 51 insufficient funds, other generic);
keep cart and order; offer retry same order or cancel
Show "checking payment" with Check again; never advise paying twice
Explain payment in progress; continue (A6) or check status
Retry same order/key (back to POST /payments); no new reservation;
leaving retains reservation, no automatic expiry
Compute server prices; lock recipes by ID (FOR SHARE);
lock ingredients by ID (FOR UPDATE); read balances
demand(i) = sum of cart quantity x
(base recipe + selected topping quantities for i).
Only tracked=true ingredients enter demand and snapshot.
Aggregate tracked ingredient demand across ALL cart lines
Missing/invalid recipe or no tracked base ingredient?
and immutable aggregate OrderIngredient snapshot; COMMIT
Validate body/key; read Order and verify ownership (no lock yet)
no new Payment, no signing, no balance mutation
BEGIN; lock Order; re-read THAT Payment;
apply result with the same function as IPN; COMMIT
Not concluded inside the grace: 00/01, or 91 before expiry?
QueryDR failed inside the grace, or special status 04/05/06/07/09, or MISMATCH?
Latest Payment PENDING and past expiresAt?
Open Payment PENDING still valid, same paymentMethod?
no open Payment, or other method
200 with the SAME paymentUrl and expiresAt (even with a new key);
Open Payment PENDING with another paymentMethod?
Sign payment URL (HMAC-SHA512, local, vnp_TxnRef = Payment.id);
BEGIN; lock Order; INSERT Payment PENDING
if retry, Order PAYMENT_FAILED to PENDING; no new reservation; COMMIT
Return 201 with paymentUrl and expiresAt (15 minutes)
Check configuration, signature, vnp_TmnCode, Payment and amount
RspCode 97 bad signature or merchant, 01 no Payment, 04 wrong amount,
BEGIN; lock Order; re-read Payment and Order
Success IPN after FAILED/EXPIRED, CANCELLED order or paid by another Payment?
RspCode 02; Order, Payment and stock unchanged
Never use edited recipes to consume old snapshots.
lock snapshot ingredients by ID (FOR UPDATE);
Verify owner; Payment already SUCCESS/FAILED returns DB state without QueryDR
Verify response; BEGIN; lock Order; re-read THAT Payment;
apply same function as IPN (00/00 SUCCESS, 00/02 FAILED);
00/01 or 91 before expiry: 409 PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS; errors: 502 (past expiresAt + 15 min: closed FAILED EXPIRED, E11); COMMIT
Payment PENDING still valid, or unresolved after QueryDR reconciliation (E11)?
Repeated cancel returns 409; no second release.
Legacy false marker restores Product.stock instead.
Same cancellation applies directly to PENDING orders.
Ingredients are never released just because a Payment became FAILED.
BEGIN; lock Order; validate owner and unpaid state;
if inventoryTracked=true: lock snapshot ingredients by ID;
otherwise restore legacy Product.stock; set CANCELLED; COMMIT
HTTP call is made outside any DB transaction holding the Order lock
Cancel transaction; response code 24, transaction status 02
No result is sent; transaction stays open until expiry
